# Healthgrades

> > Healthgrades is a comprehensive healthcare platform for finding doctors, reading patient reviews, comparing physician qualifications, and booking online appointments across medical specialties nationwide.

Healthgrades provides detailed physician directories organized by specialty and location, covering all U.S. states including major metropolitan areas like New York, San Jose, and Florida. The platform enables patients to search for healthcare providers, view ratings and reviews, verify credentials, and schedule appointments directly online.

## Key Topics

- Doctor search and physician finder tools
- Healthcare provider directories by specialty
- Patient reviews and physician ratings
- Online appointment scheduling
- Medical specialties (cardiology, clinical nursing, etc.)
- Geographic coverage (New York, California, Florida, etc.)
- Doctor qualifications and credentials
- Cardiologist specialists
- Clinical nurse specialists
- HIPAA-compliant appointment booking
- Provider comparison tools
- Metropolitan healthcare directories (Manhattan, Kendall, San Jose)
- State-by-state physician listings
- Healthcare provider reviews
- Medical practice information

## Core Platform

- [Healthgrades | Find a Doctor - Doctor Reviews - Online Doctor Appointments](https://www.healthgrades.com/): Homepage for Healthgrades doctor search, reviews, and appointment booking
- [Find a Doctor | Find a Physician - Healthgrades](https://www.healthgrades.com/find-a-doctor): Main physician finder tool for searching doctors by location and specialty

## Specialty Directories

- [20 Best Cardiologists Near Kendall, FL | Healthgrades](https://www.healthgrades.com/cardiology-directory/fl-florida/kendall): Cardiologist directory for Kendall, FL with ratings and reviews
- [20 Best Cardiologists Near Manhattan, NY | Healthgrades](https://www.healthgrades.com/cardiology-directory/ny-new-york/manhattan): Manhattan cardiologist listings including Lenox Hill and Cornell providers
- [20 Best Clinical Nurse Specialists Near New York City, NY | Healthgrades](https://www.healthgrades.com/clinical-nursing-directory/ny-new-york/new-york-city): Clinical nurse specialist directory for New York City with provider ratings

## Optional

- [Healthgrades Online Appointment Scheduling Authorization](https://www.healthgrades.com/content/hg-authorization): HIPAA authorization for appointment scheduling and PHI disclosure
